summary: Jaguar Health, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that its special meeting of stockholders on September 4, 2026, lacked a quorum and was not reconvened. No proposals from the proxy statement filed August 3, 2026, were voted on. The company will evaluate whether to call a new special meeting to consider similar proposals. This is a procedural event regarding a failed stockholder meeting, not a special-situation transaction.
